Subject: Acme — Pricing deck & next steps

Hi Alice —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and next steps: 

- Key needs: low-latency multi-region inference, private deployment option (VPC), and predictable monthly committed capacity for peak traffic.
- Success metric: <25ms p95 on text-generation requests and 30% lower cost/token vs current on-prem setup.

Attached is the pricing deck I promised (Redwood_Inference_Pricing_Deck_v2.pdf) — it includes Dedicated and Private pricing, an example deployment roadmap, and optional add-ons (observability + extended retention).

Suggested next steps:
1) I can walk you + Bob through the deck (30 minutes) to highlight recommendations for your usage patterns.
2) If it looks good, we can draft a mutual action plan and target a pilot in Q2.

Availability: I’m open THU/Fri 9–11am PT or next week afternoon PT. What works best for you?

If you didn’t get the attachment or want a stripped-down estimate we can run one based on your exact traffic profile — happy to do that.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Would you be able to do a 30-minute walkthrough next week? Here are a couple slots I have open: Tue 3/9 10:00am PT, Wed 3/10 2:00pm PT.

Thanks —
Ben
